content.short: EigenLayer is a middleware protocol on Ethereum that introduces restaking for shared security and AVS innovation.
content.description:
EigenLayer is a pioneering middleware protocol on Ethereum that introduces the concept of restaking. This mechanism allows users to repurpose their staked ETH or Liquid Staking Tokens (LSTs) to secure additional applications known as Actively Validated Services (AVS). By creating a marketplace for decentralized trust, EigenLayer enables developers to bootstrap new networks with Ethereum's robust security guarantees.

The platform lowers capital barriers for new services while providing stakers with additional yield. Through its modular architecture, EigenLayer facilitates an efficient ecosystem where security is a programmable resource. It empowers a wide range of Web3 infrastructure, including oracles and bridges, while maintaining decentralization and user sovereignty.
